reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 22. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

If Sec. Duffy and Trump admit this is a crisis, why have they only spent a fraction of this significant investment in safety?

I will always fight for veterans and their families to ensure they receive the care and benefits they have earned.

We will hold everyone who played a part in this illegal war accountable.

And that starts with Pete Hegseth. https://t.co/1gloF6JStE

Stephen Miller is a white supremacist and the chief architect of Trump’s sadistic immigration policies that have divided families, racially profiled Black and Brown people, deported immigrants to countries where they don’t belong, killed Americans in our streets, and immigrants in detention centers. He is full of hatred and division.

Trump is showing us exactly who he is by elevating this white supremacist to Chief of Staff. The American people reject his hateful vision, and Democrats will hold him and every other criminal in the Trump Administration accountable.

El arresto de la excandidata presidencial Luisa González es solo la señal más reciente del deslizamiento de Ecuador hacia un gobierno de partido único.

https://t.co/BSzYASL5wG
Proud to join this letter and demand answers on how the corrupt fraudster Flávio Bolsonaro was able to enter the U.S. so quickly, and what role the State Department played. https://t.co/GhrDFjIUgD

Our country has lost a giant. Dolores Huerta was a civil rights champion and labor leader whose early work with the United Farm Workers changed the lives of migrant workers. She dedicated her life to fighting for the rights of immigrants, women, and Latinos until the very end.

Congress must act to end this gun violence epidemic. May the victims rest in peace.

No one is safe under this lawless DHS. Not even U.S. citizens.

We must make sure these masked agents are held accountable and we must dismantle DHS. https://t.co/34CdU3x3yS

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
